caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with a fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and a wide, voluminous skirt. The dress occupies the center of the composition and is rendered with a detailed floral pattern in shades of green, yellow, pink, red, and purple on a cream or ivory background. The floral motifs are distributed evenly across the surface of the dress. The design suggests a front opening on the bodice and a defined waist. To the right of the main image is a smaller outline sketch of the same dress, drawn with simple lines and no color or pattern, showing only the contours and general shape. The background of the entire drawing is plain and light beige. The paper shows the artist’s signature in the lower right corner.
title: Dress
